answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, so holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in lagoon and kernel lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the thread graph. A farm of 1791 identities would post 4295 proofs and burn roughly 71 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
